sect3.title: Default values for readonly properties
sect3.simpara: Readonly properties may now declare default values.

informalexample.programlisting:
<?php
class Config
{
    public readonly int $timeout = 30;
}

$config = new Config();
var_dump($config->timeout); // int(30)

sect3.title: Reference assignment on WeakMap
sect3.simpara: It is now possible to use reference assignment on a WeakMap without the key needing to be present beforehand.

informalexample.programlisting:
<?php
$obj = new stdClass();
$map = new WeakMap();
$count = 0;

// Previously: Error: "Object stdClass#1 not contained in WeakMap"
$map[$obj] = &$count;
$count++;

var_dump($map[$obj]); // int(1)

sect3.title: __debugInfo on enums
sect3.simpara: It is now possible to define the __debugInfo() magic method on enums. Previously, this resulted in a fatal error.
sect3.informalexample:
<?php
enum Suit: string
{
    case Hearts = 'H';
    case Spades = 'S';

    public function __debugInfo(): array
    {
        return ['suit' => $this->name, 'symbol' => $this->value];
    }
}

var_dump(Suit::Hearts);

    
    &example.outputs;
    

enum(Suit::Hearts) (2) {
  ["suit"]=>
  string(6) "Hearts"
  ["symbol"]=>
  string(1) "H"
}

sect3.title: #[\Override] for class constants
sect3.simpara: The Override attribute can now be applied to class constants, including enum cases. As with methods and properties, a compile-time error is raised if no matching constant exists in a parent class or implemented interface.

informalexample.programlisting:
<?php
interface HasVersion
{
    const VERSION = '1.0';
}

class Package implements HasVersion
{
    #[\Override]
    const VERSION = '2.0';

    // Fatal error: Package::NAME has #[\Override] attribute,
    // but no matching parent constant exists
    // #[\Override]
    // const NAME = 'package';
}

sect3.title: Partial function application
sect3.simpara: Added support for partial function application. A call in which one or more arguments are replaced by the ? placeholder, or the remaining arguments by the ... placeholder, creates a Closure that accepts the missing arguments.

informalexample.programlisting:
<?php
function add(int $a, int $b, int $c = 0): int
{
    return $a + $b + $c;
}

// "?" replaces exactly one argument
$addOne = add(1, ?);
var_dump($addOne(5)); // int(6)

// "..." replaces all remaining arguments
$addToOne = add(1, ...);
var_dump($addToOne(2, 3)); // int(6)

// Works with any callable, including internal functions
$stripSpaces = str_replace(' ', '', ?);
var_dump($stripSpaces('a b c')); // string(3) "abc"

sect3.title: Mutating objects stored in constants
sect3.simpara: Objects stored in constants or class constants can now be mutated directly via OBJ->prop = $val.

informalexample.programlisting:
<?php
const CONFIG = new stdClass();

// Previously: "Fatal error: Cannot use temporary expression in write context"
CONFIG->debug = true;

var_dump(CONFIG->debug); // bool(true)

sect3.title: Endianness modifiers for pack() and unpack()
sect3.simpara: pack and unpack now accept the < (little-endian) and > (big-endian) modifiers after the signed and unsigned integer format codes, and after the float and double format codes.

informalexample.programlisting:
<?php echo bin2hex(pack('l>', 1)), PHP_EOL; // Prints "00000001" echo bin2hex(pack('l<', 1)), PHP_EOL; // Prints "01000000" echo bin2hex(pack('f>', 1.5)), PHP_EOL; // Prints "3fc00000"
var_dump(unpack('s>value', "\xff\xfe")); // ["value" => int(-2)]

sect2.title: cURL
sect2.simpara: The array returned by curl_getinfo now includes a new "size_delivered" key, which indicates the total number of bytes passed to the download write callback. This value can also be obtained by passing CURLINFO_SIZE_DELIVERED as the option parameter. Requires libcurl 8.20.0 or later.

Added CURLOPT_SEEKFUNCTION to register a callback that repositions a streamed request body, so libcurl can rewind and resend it on a redirect, multi-pass authentication, or a retried reused connection instead of failing with CURLE_SEND_FAIL_REWIND. The callback receives the CurlHandle, offset and origin, and must return one of CURL_SEEKFUNC_OK, CURL_SEEKFUNC_FAIL or CURL_SEEKFUNC_CANTSEEK.

sect2.title: Date
sect2.simpara: Added the Time\Duration class.

sect2.title: FileInfo
sect2.simpara: finfo_file now works with remote streams.

sect2.title: GMP
sect2.simpara: Added gmp_powm_sec for side-channel quiet modular exponentiation. Requires GNU MP 5.0.0 or later; it is not available on official Windows builds using MPIR.

Added gmp_prevprime to get the largest prime smaller than the given number. The optional definitely_prime output parameter indicates whether the returned number is definitely prime, as opposed to probably prime. A ValueError is thrown if no such prime exists. This function is only available when PHP is built against GNU MP 6.3.0 or later; it is not available on official Windows builds using MPIR.

sect2.title: Intl
sect2.simpara: Added the static methods IntlDatePatternGenerator::getSkeleton and IntlDatePatternGenerator::getBaseSkeleton to generate the unique skeleton and base skeleton for a date/time pattern.
Added Locale::getDisplayKeyword and Locale::getDisplayKeywordValue, with the aliases locale_get_display_keyword and locale_get_display_keyword_value, respectively.
sect2.para:
Added the IntlNumberRangeFormatter class to format an interval of two numbers with a given skeleton and locale. It is supported as of ICU 63. The collapse behavior is one of:
IntlNumberRangeFormatter::COLLAPSE_AUTO IntlNumberRangeFormatter::COLLAPSE_NONE IntlNumberRangeFormatter::COLLAPSE_UNIT IntlNumberRangeFormatter::COLLAPSE_ALL
The identity fallback is one of:
IntlNumberRangeFormatter::IDENTITY_FALLBACK_SINGLE_VALUE IntlNumberRangeFormatter::IDENTITY_FALLBACK_APPROXIMATELY_OR_SINGLE_VALUE IntlNumberRangeFormatter::IDENTITY_FALLBACK_APPROXIMATELY IntlNumberRangeFormatter::IDENTITY_FALLBACK_RANGE
sect2.simpara: Added SpoofChecker::areBidiConfusable to check whether two strings are confusable for a given text direction, along with the SpoofChecker::LTR and SpoofChecker::RTL direction constants. It is supported as of ICU 74.
Added SpoofChecker::getBidiSkeleton to generate a confusable skeleton for a given text direction. It is supported as of ICU 74.
Added SpoofChecker::getSkeleton to generate a confusable skeleton for a given string.

sect2.title: IO
sect2.para:
Added a new polling API, consisting of:
The Io\Poll\Context and Io\Poll\Watcher classes The Io\Poll\Backend and Io\Poll\Event enums The Io\Poll\Handle interface The StreamPollHandle class to watch streams

sect2.title: JSON
sect2.simpara: Added extra information about the error location to the error messages returned by json_last_error_msg and to the message of JsonException.

sect2.title: OpenSSL
sect2.para:
Added TLS session resumption support for streams. This allows saving and restoring client sessions across requests, implementing custom server-side session storage, and controlling session cache behavior, using the following new SSL context options:
session_data session_new_cb session_cache session_cache_size session_timeout session_id_context session_get_cb session_remove_cb num_tickets
sect2.simpara: Added TLS external PSK support for streams with the new SSL context options psk_client_cb and psk_server_cb. This allows setting and receiving pre-shared keys.

Added TLS 1.3 early data (0-RTT) support for streams. Clients send early data with the early_data SSL context option; servers accept it with max_early_data and receive it through the early_data_cb callback. The outcome is reported as "accepted", "rejected" or "not_sent" in the "early_data" key of the "crypto" entry of the stream_get_meta_data array.

sect2.title: PDO_PGSQL
sect2.simpara: Added Pdo\Pgsql::ATTR_CHUNK_SIZE, the number of rows a statement fetches per chunk. A value of 1 or more enters the lazy fetch mode of PDO::ATTR_PREFETCH => 0. Setting PDO::ATTR_PREFETCH replaces the chunk size. Statements that are prepared with neither it nor PDO::ATTR_PREFETCH fall back to the value set on the connection. Requires libpq 17 or later.

sect2.title: Phar
sect2.simpara: Overriding the SplFileInfo::getMTime and SplFileInfo::getPathname methods now influences the result of the Phar::buildFromDirectory and Phar::buildFromIterator family of methods. This makes it possible to override the timestamp and names of files.

sect2.title: SNMP
sect2.simpara: It is now possible to use AES192, AES192C, AES256, and AES256C as SNMPv3 security protocols if the underlying library supports them.
It is now possible to reset the MIB tree using the new snmp_init_mib function.
sect2.para:
Additional MIB parsing and output control functionality has been exposed via:
snmp_set_mib_option snmp_set_output_option snmp_set_string_output_format SNMP::$numeric_index SNMP::$numeric_timeticks SNMP::$extended_index SNMP::$dont_print_units SNMP::$escape_quotes SNMP::$print_hex_text SNMP::setOidOutputFormat SNMP::setStringOutputFormat

sect2.title: Streams
sect2.para:
Added a new stream errors API, consisting of:
The StreamError and StreamException classes The StreamErrorStore, StreamErrorMode, and StreamErrorCode enums The stream_last_errors and stream_clear_errors functions
It is controlled using the error_mode, error_store and error_handler stream context options.
sect2.simpara: Added the filter.max_filter_count stream context option for php://filter URLs. When set, opening the stream fails with a warning if the URL would add more filters than the configured value. Negative values disable the check.
Added the socket context option so_reuseaddr that allows disabling address reuse (SO_REUSEADDR) and explicitly uses SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE on Windows.
Added the socket context options so_keepalive, tcp_keepidle, tcp_keepintvl and tcp_keepcnt that allow setting socket keepalive options.

Added the socket context option so_linger that sets SO_LINGER on TCP sockets. A positive value enables lingering for that many seconds, zero or a negative value disables it. Values above 65535 are clamped as the linger time is limited to an unsigned short on some platforms.

Added the socket context options so_rcvbuf and so_sndbuf that set the socket receive and send buffer sizes in bytes (SO_RCVBUF and SO_SNDBUF) on TCP and UDP sockets. The value must be an integer between 1 and 2147483647, any other value makes the stream creation fail. The operating system may round, cap or otherwise adjust the requested size, and may stop sizing that buffer automatically, so the size read back can differ from the one requested.
Filtered streams can now be cast to file descriptors for use with stream_select.
sect2.para:
Added the "write_seek_mode" filter parameter for the bz2, iconv, zlib, and string stream filters. This parameter must be set via an associative array where the key is "write_seek_mode" and the value is one of the following strings:
"preserve" "reset" "strict"

sect2.title: URI
sect2.simpara: Added Uri\Rfc3986\Uri::getUriType and Uri\WhatWg\Url::isSpecialScheme.
Added Uri\Rfc3986\Uri::getHostType and Uri\WhatWg\Url::getHostType.
Added the Uri\Rfc3986\UriBuilder and Uri\WhatWg\UrlBuilder classes.
Added Uri\WhatWg\url_percent_encode.
